name: Do I need to be home during cracked window glass replacement?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to be home during cracked window glass replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it is generally recommended that an adult be present during the cracked window glass replacement process. This allows our technicians to access the window area, clarify any details, and address questions that may arise during the installation. Your presence also ensures that the work meets your expectations and allows you to confirm the completion of the job to your satisfaction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, an adult should be home during the replacement process to provide access, clarify details, and confirm satisfaction with the work.
